name: Duppy
description: A spirit of the dead in Jamaican and wider Caribbean folklore, of West African (especially Ga and Akan) origin, generally regarded as malevolent and haunting at night.

aliases.name: Rolling Calf
aliases.meaning: specific malevolent duppy in the form of a chained calf

origin: Jamaican folklore is the densest locus of duppy tradition; cognate beliefs span the Anglophone Caribbean (Bahamas, Barbados, the Caymans, Belize, Guyana) and the wider Caribbean diaspora in the United Kingdom, United States, and Canada. The tradition has antecedents in the Ga and Akan cosmologies of present-day Ghana.
